sources.period: 2022 tariff notice used as pricing-rule reference
sources.basis: Headworks supply fee and actual pumping fuel/electricity are separate. The 0.20/0.80 CNY/m3 all-in service contracts below are declared estimates, not the regulated headworks tariff or observed 2025 farm-delivered quotes.

40 CNY/t throughput benchmark adopted as a fixed contracted batch-service assumption. Not a universal per-moisture-point tariff; only actual processing throughput charged; safe grain skipped at no charge.

sources.publisher: 河南省政府采购网，镇平县2025年防灾救灾采购需求
sources.basis: China-wide cost-scale cross-check only, not Northeast observations, not the retained US product SKUs, not formulation equivalence and not field efficacy evidence. Product and ground-service estimates remain explicitly declared.

water.explanation: Purchased irrigation service includes pumping energy and conveyance. High-price fields use higher-lift/costlier pumping. The engine meters delivered water; pumping service is not charged again as tractor fuel. Neither is a provincial unified agricultural tariff. Physical caps forbid overquota use; no invented progressive surcharge.

contract_assumptions.protection_price_status: Unverified product-specific China price estimates. US brands/labels retained for continuity; do not claim these are registered Chinese soybean SKUs or observed 2025 Northeast quotes. A source-verified Chinese product catalogue is a separate agronomic change.

scope: 2025 Northeast economic benchmarks in fixed USD, applied to the existing experimental farms. Source observations, category proxies and declared service/supplier estimates are distinguished. This does not calibrate WOFOST varieties, soil, climate or pesticide efficacy to Chinese farms. No VAT, FX speculation, rent, ordinary labour or depreciation model added; contracted protection service is charged once.
